_comment: Wavy-valley fig1 testbed. V(x1,x2) = 0.6*(x2 - sin(pi x1/2))^2 - 0.5*x1. The minimum-energy curve is x2 = sin(pi x1/2). Particles fall onto the valley quickly, then drift slowly downhill (-x1 direction) along it. The synth_* fields below are GENERIC defaults (uniform snapshot schedule); the published Fig-1 run overrides them via the experiment preset configs/experiment/wavy_valley_fig1_*.json (irregular snapshot_times, normal init at [-3,1], beta=0.00625). Composed as 'wavy_valley:stitching:wavy_valley_fig1_stitching' by the `wavy_valley` experiment (python -m experiments all wavy_valley).
